The Z-average particle size (DLS Z-Ave) and polydispersity index (PDI) results of the latex particles obtained from DLS experiments are also provided in Table 1 . To test for reversibility in temperature response; the measurements were first taken at (i) a temperature of about 40*C, then at (ii) a temperature of about 20'C and finally (iii) at a temperature of about 40'C.
